## ☀️ Morning Job Digest

**The autonomous demo showstopper.**

Every weekday at 8am ET, this workflow:
1. Runs Job Discovery automatically
2. Takes the top 3 highest-fit jobs
3. Formats a Telegram message
4. Delivers it to your phone — zero user input

**Setup:**
- Set `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` in .env
- Set `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` in .env
- Activate this workflow

**It already ran this morning — show the message on your phone during the demo!**

## 📱 Telegram Message Format

```
🌅 CareerForge Morning Digest
Wednesday, April 9

🔥 3 new high-fit jobs found!

1️⃣ Senior ML Engineer @ OpenAI
   ⭐ Fit Score: 9.2/10
   💰 $200k-$280k | Remote
   💡 Perfect match — LLM experience

2️⃣ Staff AI Engineer @ Anthropic
   ⭐ Fit Score: 8.8/10
   ...

📊 Market: Strong demand, $180k-$280k avg
```
